summary: Fuller and cloth-maker of Long Melford, Suffolk, about 1517; John's 14th-great-grandfather.
bio: John Hamonde was a fuller, or cloth-finisher, and cloth-maker of Long Melford in Suffolk around 1517. He was executor of the will of John Hamond the elder of Melford, dated 1517 and proved 1528. The Hammonds and the Warrens were neighbours on Hall Street in Melford. A connection further back to the Hammonds of Lawshall has been suggested but is speculative.
